providers.label: mevblocker-rpc
providers.log_window_basis: Documented 10,000-block window; probe run 36589205446 scanned 915 such windows per filter with zero failed items. Probe run 36590720390 measured up to about 8,500 account logs (5.4 MB) per window, so a batch carries at most four windows.

providers.label: tenderly-public
providers.log_window_basis: Probe run 36590720390 served 10,000-block account-log windows (1,937 logs) in 0.6 s; half of that window bounds the densest measured windows below about 4,300 logs per response. Batching is not supported.
